intro: Stockholm rewards visitors with walkable islands, world-class museums, and a calm, watery beauty. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro (Tunnelbana) is fast and covers the city; buy an SL card or use the app.
Trams and buses fill the gaps; SL travel card is best value.
Taxis are pricey; use Uber or Bolt for app-based rides.
Driving is not recommended in the centre due to congestion and tolls.
Walking and cycling are great in warm months; many bike lanes.
Ferries connect the islands and are part of the transit network.

vasa.name: Vasa Museum
vasa.price_text: ≈ SEK 190 adult · under 18 free · check current price
vasa.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · longer in summer · check on the day
vasa.tip: Go right at opening or after 15:00 to avoid the biggest crowds. The guided tour in English is worth it.

gamla-stan.name: Gamla Stan
gamla-stan.tip: Leave the main street Västerlånggatan and wander the quiet side lanes early in the morning.

stockholm-palace.name: Stockholm Palace
stockholm-palace.price_text: ≈ SEK 180 adult · check current price and combined tickets
stockholm-palace.hours: Roughly daily 10:00–17:00 in summer · shorter off-season · check on the day
stockholm-palace.tip: Time your visit for the changing of the guard in the outer courtyard, usually around midday.

city-hall.name: Stockholm City Hall
city-hall.price_text: ≈ SEK 150 guided tour only · check current price
city-hall.hours: Guided tours only, roughly daily · check on the day
city-hall.tip: You can only see the Golden Hall and Blue Hall on a guided tour, so book a slot ahead.

skansen.name: Skansen
skansen.price_text: ≈ SEK 240 adult in summer · lower off-season · check current price
skansen.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · longer in summer · check on the day
skansen.tip: It is big. Pick two or three areas, see the Nordic animals and old houses, and allow half a day.

abba.name: ABBA The Museum
abba.price_text: ≈ SEK 250 adult · check current price, book online
abba.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
abba.tip: Book a timed ticket online. It is on Djurgården, so pair it with the Vasa Museum nearby.

metro-art.name: Stockholm Metro Art
metro-art.price_text: ≈ SEK 43 single ticket · 75 minutes of travel · check current price
metro-art.tip: The Blue Line stations T-Centralen, Kungsträdgården and Solna Centrum are the highlights. One ticket covers the ride.

birka.name: Birka and Hovgården
birka.price_text: ≈ SEK 350–450 including boat from central Stockholm · check current price
birka.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–September · boat times vary · check on the day
birka.tip: It is a full-day trip by boat. Book ahead in summer and bring a windproof layer for the crossing.

drottningholm.name: Drottningholm Palace
drottningholm.price_text: ≈ SEK 160 palace · gardens free · check current price
drottningholm.hours: Roughly daily in summer · shorter off-season · check on the day
drottningholm.tip: Take the boat from City Hall instead of the metro. The gardens are free and worth the trip alone.

friends-arena.name: Friends Arena
friends-arena.price_text: Ticket price depends on the event
friends-arena.hours: Only on event days · check the programme
friends-arena.tip: It is outside the city centre in Solna. Take the commuter train and arrive early on match or concert nights.

grona-lund.name: Gröna Lund
grona-lund.price_text: Entry often free · ride wristband ≈ SEK 400 · check current price
grona-lund.hours: Seasonal, roughly April–September · check on the day
grona-lund.tip: Buy the ride wristband online and go on a weekday evening for shorter queues.

junibacken.name: Junibacken
junibacken.price_text: ≈ SEK 200 adult · children cheaper · check current price
junibacken.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
junibacken.tip: Best for families with young children. The Story Train ride is the highlight.

kth.name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology
kth.tip: Only worth a detour if you like architecture. The main building and courtyard are the photo spot.

kottbullar.name: Köttbullar (Swedish meatballs)
kottbullar.price_text: ≈ SEK 150–250 a plate in a mid-range restaurant
kottbullar.tip: Order them with lingonberry, cream sauce and boiled potatoes. Lunch menus are much cheaper than dinner.

national-library.name: National Library of Sweden
national-library.hours: Roughly Mon–Fri daytime · check on the day
national-library.tip: A quiet stop for book lovers. The reading room is the reason to come.

riddarholmen.name: Riddarholmen Church
riddarholmen.hours: Summer only, roughly daily · check on the day
riddarholmen.tip: Small but atmospheric. Combine it with a walk along the Riddarholmen waterfront at sunset.

sergels-torg.name: Sergels Torg
sergels-torg.tip: The glass triangle and fountain are the classic meeting point. Cross to Drottninggatan for the shopping street.

public-library.name: Stockholm Public Library
public-library.hours: Roughly daily · check on the day
public-library.tip: Walk up to the round rotunda reading room. It is a short detour from Odenplan.

stortorget.name: Stortorget, Stockholm
stortorget.tip: The colourful old houses are the classic photo. Come before 09:00 to have the square almost to yourself.

under-bridges.name: Under the Bridges of Stockholm
under-bridges.price_text: ≈ SEK 250–350 boat tour · check current price
under-bridges.hours: Seasonal, roughly April–October · several departures daily
under-bridges.tip: Sit on the open deck for photos. The tour passes under low bridges, so it is a good way to see the city from the water.

ostermalms-saluhall.name: Östermalms Saluhall
ostermalms-saluhall.price_text: ≈ SEK 100–200 for lunch at a counter
ostermalms-saluhall.hours: Roughly Mon–Sat daytime · check on the day
ostermalms-saluhall.tip: A classic food hall for a sit-down lunch. Try a shrimp sandwich or a pastry from the counters.

monteliusvagen.name: Monteliusvägen viewpoint
monteliusvagen.tip: A short cliff walk on Södermalm with the best free view of Gamla Stan and the water. Go at sunset.

sofo-walk.name: SoFo neighbourhood walk
sofo-walk.tip: Wander the streets south of Folkungagatan for small shops, cafés and street art. Good for a slow afternoon.

fika.name: Fika at a classic café
fika.price_text: ≈ SEK 60–100 for coffee and a cinnamon bun
fika.tip: Fika is the Swedish coffee break. Order a kanelbulle with your coffee and sit down, do not rush.

archipelago-tour.name: Stockholm archipelago boat trip
archipelago-tour.price_text: ≈ SEK 250–450 depending on route · check current price
archipelago-tour.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–September · check on the day
archipelago-tour.tip: Even a short hop to an island like Fjäderholmarna gives you the archipelago feel without a full day.

sodermalm-view.name: Södermalm waterfront and Fotografiska area
sodermalm-view.price_text: Free to walk · museum ticket separate
sodermalm-view.tip: Walk the quays east of Slussen for water views and cafés. A good evening stroll after dinner.

plans.for: One packed day: the Vasa ship, old-town lanes and metro art, all close together.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Ferries, green islands and water everywhere.

stays.why: Central and practical. Walk to Gamla Stan and the station; most metro lines meet here.
Sleep in the old town. Pretty lanes, but noisy in summer and few lifts in old buildings.
Cafés, bars and viewpoints. A short metro or walk south of the centre; good value.
Quiet, upmarket and close to Djurgården's museums and parkland.

food: Try Swedish classics: meatballs with lingonberry, pickled herring, and cinnamon buns (kanelbullar).
Lunch is the value meal. Many restaurants serve a weekday 'dagens lunch' for around SEK 120–160.
Fika is a coffee-and-pastry break. Sit down mid-afternoon like the locals do.
Södermalm and Vasastan have the best casual food streets; book dinner spots ahead on weekends.
Alcohol is expensive and sold in state shops (Systembolaget). Check opening hours before you shop.
more_time: Take a ferry to Djurgården for the Vasa Museum and Skansen if you have a spare half-day.
Swap a city afternoon for a short archipelago boat trip; check timetables and weather on the day.
Rainy day? The metro art walk and the City Hall tour fill a few hours cheaply.
